Story attendance cards explain plugin fibers.

scenes.heading: ## દૃશ્ય 7 — ચિઠ્ઠીનો આખો રસ્તો: tool pipeline
scenes.title: ચિઠ્ઠીનો આખો રસ્તો: tool pipeline
scenes.description: Aarav follows recipe slip through logged request, policy guard, storeroom work, completion and logged result. Technical inset use THREE SEPARATE ROWS with no crossing arrows: ALLOW -> execute -> validate/render -> finalize; DENY -> error result -> finalize (NO execute, NO validate/render); THROW -> error result -> finalize (NO validate/render). Under all rows show one shared principle: tool/call BEFORE work, tool/result AFTER finalize. Do not draw errors flowing through output schema validation. Keep labels short, no fabricated code.
